seo.title: Solar panels for businesses in PACA | Soliance
seo.description: Industrial roofs, APER-law parking canopies, business EV chargers and collective self-consumption: free profitability study, leasing and delivery in PACA.

hero.title: Your roof is an asset. Put it to work.
hero.lead: Industrial roofs, parking canopies, agricultural and commercial buildings from 36 to 500 kWp. Profitability study, lease financing, installation and maintenance by a single team in PACA.
hero.imageAlt: Solar canopy over a company car park, aerial view

industrialRoofs.title: Industrial & agricultural roofs
industrialRoofs.description: Steel deck, membrane, fibre cement to replace, farm sheds: from 15 to 500 kWp, as self-consumption with storage, total sale or collective self-consumption. E.g. <exampleLink>Vergers Niçois, 15 kWp + 12 kWh</exampleLink>.
industrialRoofs.imageAlt: Vergers Niçois farm shed fitted with 15 kWp

carports.title: Parking canopies
carports.description: APER-law compliance for car parks over 1,500 m², combined with EV charging points.

evCharging.title: Business EV chargers
evCharging.description: Fleets and visitor car parks, 22 kW chargers, monitoring and billing through a charge point operator.
evCharging.imageAlt: Fleet of vans charging on company charging points

collectives.title: Local authorities, condominiums & landlords
collectives.description: Collective self-consumption across one owner's buildings or between neighbours: one roof's output powers several buildings. E.g. <exampleLink>Pertuis gymnasium, 163 kWp</exampleLink>.
collectives.imageAlt: Pertuis municipal gymnasium fitted with 163 kWp

solisInvest.name: Solis Invest
solisInvest.title: Solis Invest: 148 kWp on an office building, with the electricity sold to the tenants.
solisInvest.description: The owner of a commercial building open to the public put solar on its flat roof and sells the output to the companies renting the building, through a collective self-consumption scheme. For the owner, a property asset that earns money; for the tenants, local electricity cheaper than the grid.
solisInvest.statsLabel: Key figures of the Solis Invest installation
solisInvest.equipment: La Francilienne 450 W full black panels · K2 S-Dome ballast with no roof-membrane penetration · legal entity, Enedis agreement and tenant allocation set up by Soliance.
solisInvest.imageAlt: Solis Invest: 148 kWp on the roof of an office building facing the Baie des Anges

seranonSpar.name: Spar in Séranon
seranonSpar.title: Spar in Séranon: 36 kWp for a shop that uses power all day long.
seranonSpar.description: Refrigeration, lighting, tills: a supermarket consumes while the sun shines. 88% of the output is used on site, with no battery, and the surplus is sold. The result: a third of the shop's electricity produced on its own roof and an investment paid back in under 3 years.

studyCta.title: A roof, a car park, a fleet? We price the project within 10 days.
studyCta.lead: Yield study, simulation of the most profitable scheme (self-consumption, sale, collective), technical note and firm proposal. No commitment, carried out by our engineering office.
studyCta.note: Reply within 48 h · free site visit

schemes.title: Four ways to make a roof or a car park pay
schemes.intro: The rules are not the same as for homes: for a business, selling and sharing the output remain real levers. The study compares the scenarios.

totalSale.title: Total sale under a feed-in tariff
totalSale.definition: up to 500 kWp, the operator sells 100% of the output to EDF OA at a tariff set by decree for 20 years.
totalSale.audience: roofs and sheds whose building uses little power (storage, farming, landlords).
totalSale.keyPoint: profitability depends on the yield and on the tariff of the quarter in which the grid connection is requested, not on consumption.
totalSale.imageAlt: Logistics warehouse with its roof fully covered in panels, power pylon in the distance

diagram.target: Sold to EDF OA over 20 years

collectiveSelfConsumption.title: Collective self-consumption
collectiveSelfConsumption.definition: a scheme in which several nearby consumers (2 km, up to 20 km in rural areas) share the output of one or more installations, through an organising legal entity (PMO) and Enedis metering.
collectiveSelfConsumption.audience: business parks, condominiums, landlords, local authorities.
collectiveSelfConsumption.keyPoint: the shared electricity is sold at a price agreed between members, without going through a supplier.
collectiveSelfConsumption.imageAlt: Solis Invest: commercial roof under collective self-consumption

thirdPartyInvestment.title: Third-party investment and roof leasing
thirdPartyInvestment.definition: an investor funds, runs and maintains the plant; the owner receives rent or buys the electricity produced at a lower price, without tying up capital.
thirdPartyInvestment.audience: large roofs, buildings to renovate or clear of asbestos, car parks.
thirdPartyInvestment.keyPoint: less profitable than buying outright with lease financing, but zero investment and zero operation.
thirdPartyInvestment.imageAlt: Industrial roof with solar panels at sunset

aperCarports.title: APER law: parking canopies
aperCarports.definition: the obligation to cover at least half of the surface of outdoor car parks over 1,500 m² with solar canopies, with deadlines depending on size.
aperCarports.audience: shops, business parks, local authorities, logistics sites.
aperCarports.keyPoint: the obligation becomes an asset: output sold or shared, built-in EV charging, shade for users. Delivered with our specialist partners.
aperCarports.imageAlt: Solar canopies over a retail park car park

individualSelfConsumption.title: Individual self-consumption with surplus sale
individualSelfConsumption.description: The building uses its own output and sells the rest. Ideal when daytime consumption is high (refrigeration, production, offices). Battery optional.

creTenders.title: CRE tenders (> 500 kWp)
creTenders.description: Above 500 kWp, the tariff is obtained through a tender. We support the application with our developer partners.

taxation.title: Depreciation and tax
taxation.description: Depreciable plant, VAT recovered, BPCE Lease leasing with no down payment: the profitability study includes the financing structure.
